title: Friday Daily Practice
subtitle: Weekly quiz 5 (20 marks): words, Task 1 grouping, matching information and the passive
source: Daily Practice Week 5 và Weekly Quiz Week 5 (print/W5/src), đáp án theo bản Key của thầy.
intro: Làm lần lượt các bước, khoảng 30 phút. Quiz 20 điểm, làm trong 30 phút, một mình, không xem tài liệu. Câu 11–12 (nhóm số liệu) thầy chấm, các câu còn lại web chấm tự động. Hạn nộp 00:00 đêm cùng ngày. Đủ và đúng hạn được 20 Meow, muộn hoặc làm một nửa được 10 Meow. Đừng xem đáp án trước khi làm xong.

steps.title: Step 1 · Part A: vocabulary 1–6 (6 marks, 5 min)
steps.instructions: Fill each gap with one phrase from the box, in the correct form. Use each phrase once. Box: subscription · plummeted · accounted for · encounter · misinformation · reliable source

items.label: 1. Fake stories and rumours are examples of ______.
2. Women ______ 55% of the students in the survey.
3. We often ______ news online by accident.
4. A government website is a ______; a rumour is not.
5. Print sales ______ from 40 to 5 minutes a day.
6. A digital ______ to the paper costs $5 a month.

steps.title: Step 3 · Part B: group the data 11–12 (2 marks, 5 min)
steps.instructions: The table shows litres of drink per person in one country. Group the four drinks into two groups by trend. Write the names and the trend of each group (1 mark each). Mr. Nam marks this part.

images.alt: Table: litres of coffee, tea, juice and water per person in 2000, 2010 and 2020

open.q: 11–12. Two groups and the trend of each group
open.model: Group 1: Coffee and Water rose. Group 2: Tea fell and Juice stayed stable. Another grouping is fine if the reason is correct.

steps.title: Step 4 · Part B: prepositions 13–14 (2 marks, 2 min)

items.explain: from … to: từ mức này đến mức kia.

items.q: 14. The number of visitors increased ______ 5% in 2020.

steps.title: Step 5 · Part B: correct the mistake 15 (1 mark, 2 min)

items.label: 15. The number of tourists was rise. → ______
items.explain: Không dùng was + rise. Dùng động từ quá khứ: rose (hoặc increased).

steps.title: Step 6 · Part C: reading, matching information 16–18 (3 marks, 8 min)
steps.instructions: Read the passage. Which paragraph, A–D, contains the following information? Write A, B, C or D. You may use any letter more than once. One letter is not used.
steps.passage:
Podcasts as a news source

A. Podcasts have become a popular way to follow the news. According to a recent survey, the number of adults who listen to a news podcast every week has doubled in five years, from 6 million to 12 million.

B. Listeners say the main attraction is convenience. A podcast can be played on a commute, in the gym or while cooking, so people can keep up to date without sitting in front of a screen. Many also like that most episodes are free.

C. However, podcasts have a weakness. Unlike newspapers, most shows have no editor who checks the facts before they are published, so mistakes and rumours can spread easily. Some hosts also give their own opinions without saying so.

D. Experts expect the audience to keep growing. They predict that within three years, one in four adults will listen to a news podcast at least once a month.

items.label: 16. a problem with podcasts  ______
items.explain: Bằng chứng: đoạn C, most shows have no editor who checks the facts.

items.label: 17. a reason why people enjoy listening while they do other things  ______
items.explain: Bằng chứng: đoạn B, played on a commute, in the gym or while cooking.

items.label: 18. the number of weekly listeners  ______
items.explain: Bằng chứng: đoạn A, from 6 million to 12 million. Bẫy: đoạn D có one in four adults, nhưng đó là dự đoán, không phải số người nghe hằng tuần.

steps.title: Step 7 · Part D: passive 19–20 (2 marks, 3 min)

items.q: 19. Researchers found the story to be false.

options.A: The story was found to be false by researchers.
options.B: The story found to be false by researchers.
options.C: The story has found to be false by researchers.

items.explain: Bị động quá khứ đơn: was + found.

items.q: 20. Many people are sharing the video.

options.A: The video shared by many people.
options.B: The video is sharing by many people.
options.C: The video is being shared by many people.

items.explain: Bị động hiện tại tiếp diễn: is being + shared.
